proves.claim: Submitting a parent at a new commit reopens each dependent whose recorded after-gate base holds the old head, with a note naming the old and the new head.

store.io-board-submit.new-parent-head-re.why: Without this test a dependent built on a parent's old head stays in review after the parent changed, and lands work proven against code that is gone.

proves.claim: Submitting a parent at the same commit its dependents were built on leaves every dependent as it was.

store.io-board-submit.same-parent-head-l.why: Without this test every parent resubmit could send its dependents back and undo review work that is still valid.
